entries.title: Public voting: the ballot shows your plan name and instructions
entries.summary: the heading on a public voting ballot is now the evaluation plan's name (the awards program's name on an awards round) and the text under it is the round's instructions, formatting included, in place of the generic *Cast your vote* copy. Works on event, Interest Form and awards rounds.

where.path: Public voting ballot on the Site

entries.use_case: The ballot heading is the plan (or awards program) name and the text under it is the round's instructions, so voters land on something that reads like the customer's vote, not a generic form.

cs_action.note: Customers with a live vote should check their round instructions now show on the ballot.

internal.who_should_get_it: Events and awards programs with public voting.

entries.title: Who can vote on Interest Form and awards rounds
entries.summary: the **Ballot** and **Who can vote** groups from event evaluation plans now appear on Interest Form rounds and on awards rounds set to Public voting: random ballots with a per-voter size and **Reset ballots**, an eligible-voter list you upload with **Ticket holder** / **Community member** groups, and ×2 / ×1 weighting. Round results on both add **Weighted avg** and **Distinct voters** with an **All voters / Ticket holders / Community** filter. **Votes per voter** on an Interest Form round is now enforced on the ballot and shown to voters as their budget.

enable.path: Round → Public voting → Ballot and Who can vote groups

where.path: Awards → program → round; CRM → Interest Forms → Evaluations → round

entries.use_case: People's-choice awards and community votes can restrict voting to ticket holders or members, weight their votes, deal random ballots, and report distinct voters — the controls event plans already had.

internal.when_to_bring_up: Awards customers planning a public/people's choice round; Interest Form community votes.
